propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without any retry wrapper, leaving it outside the self-healing seam that protects all other store git operations
three CI test runs failed identically with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' when bundling a merged tip, proving a transient object-database read failure made a commit object momentarily unreadable
the exact failure signature is a missing loose object (not corrupt or empty), reproduced deterministically by deleting the merge commit object before the bundle call
gitutil already implements transient-read retry and per-store advisory locking for other git operations, but s3_doctor does not reuse these seams
routing s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write and adding the 'bad object' signature to the transient-marker family allows the proven fault class to self-heal rather than fail
a bundle failure surviving retries now raises an error distinguishing object-database read failure rather than misdirecting the operator to 'rebar fsck-recover' for a merge that never conflicted
